item.description:
ReadingPaper 2.5.0

The app is now called ReadingPaper, with a new icon. It was "Reader for Instapaper"; the new name and artwork carry none of Instapaper's trademarks or trade dress. It's still the same unaffiliated client for the same account — you stay signed in, and your reader settings, folders and reading progress all carry over.

  • Installs from a disk image. Releases now ship as a .dmg with the usual drag-to-Applications window.
  • Updates itself. New versions are found, downloaded and installed in the background — no more copying builds between Macs. There's a ReadingPaper ▸ Check for Updates… menu item if you'd rather not wait.

This is the last version you'll have to install by hand.
